description_en: Modifies the draft definition of an API. Unlike the ModifyApi operation, this operation does not require all API information. You only need to specify the parameters that you want to modify. For example, to change the authentication method of an API from anonymous to APP, you only need to set AuthType to APP
description_zh: 本API用于修改API的草稿定义信息，区别于接口ModifyApi，不需要填充所有的API信息才能操作，只需指定要修改的参数进行修改。例如，当需要修改API的认证方式从匿名变为APP认证，只需要传入AuthType的值APP即可
name: ModifyApiConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API
parameters.help_zh: API的ID标识
parameters.name: api_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the API
parameters.help_zh: API名称
parameters.name: api_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the API
parameters.help_zh: api描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the API is public. Valid values:
PUBLIC: Public. If you select this value, the online definition of the API is visible on the Discover APIs page in the console of all users.
PRIVATE: Private. If you select this value and the API group is listed in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace, the private API is not listed
parameters.help_zh:
API是否公开，可以取值：

PUBLIC：公开，如选择此类型，该API的线上环境定义，会在所有用户的控制台“发现API”页面可见。
PRIVATE：不公开，如选择此类型，当该组API在云市场上架时，私有类型的API不会上架
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to force the check of the X-Ca-Nonce header in requests. X-Ca-Nonce is a unique identifier for a request and is typically a UUID. After API Gateway receives this parameter, it verifies the validity of the parameter. The same value can be used only once within 15 minutes. This effectively prevents replay attacks on the API. Valid values:
true: Forces the check of X-Ca-Nonce.
false: Does not check X-Ca-Nonce. If you do not specify this parameter when you modify the API, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh:
设置ForceNonceCheck为true, 请求时强制检查X-Ca-Nonce，这个是请求的唯一标识，一般使用UUID来标识。API网关收到这个参数后会校验这个参数的有效性，同样的值，15分内只能被使用一次。可以有效防止API的重放攻击。
设置ForceNonceCheck为false, 则不检查。修改时，不设置则不修改原来的取值
parameters.name: force_nonce_check

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable Internet access to the API. Valid values:
true: Disables Internet access. The API can be called only over the internal network.
false: Enables Internet access. Calls to the API are not restricted
parameters.help_zh:
设置DisableInternet为true, 仅支持内网调用API。
设置DisableInternet为false, 则不限制调用
parameters.name: disable_internet

parameters.help_en:
The AppCode authentication type. This parameter takes effect only when AuthType is set to APP. Valid values:
DEFAULT: Default. If you do not specify this parameter, the value is DEFAULT, which means the setting of the API group is used.
DISABLE: Not allowed.
HEADER: Allows AppCode authentication in the header.
HEADER_QUERY: Allows AppCode authentication in the header and query string
parameters.help_zh:
当AuthType为APP认证时，可选值如下：

DEFAULT：不传默认是DEFAULT（随分组设置）
DISABLE：不允许
HEADER：允许AppCode的Header认证
HEADER_QUERY：允许AppCode的Header及Query认证
parameters.name: app_code_auth_type

parameters.help_en:
The signature algorithm. This parameter is required when AuthType is set to APP. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is HmacSHA256. Valid values:
HmacSHA256
HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256
parameters.help_zh:
当AuthType为APP认证时，需要传该值明确签名算法。可选值如下，不传默认是HmacSHA256：

HmacSHA256
HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256
parameters.name: allow_signature_method

parameters.help_en:
The security authentication type of the API. Valid values:
APP: Only authorized applications can call the API.
ANONYMOUS: Anonymous calls are allowed. If you set this parameter to ANONYMOUS, take note of the following items:
     - Anyone who can obtain the API service information can call the API. API Gateway does not authenticate the caller and cannot configure user-level throttling. If you make the API public, configure API-level throttling.
     - The value of AppCodeAuthType does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
API安全认证类型，目前可以取值：

APP：只允许已授权的APP调用
ANONYMOUS：允许匿名调用，设置为允许匿名调用需要注意：
     - 任何能够获取该API服务信息的人，都将能够调用该API。网关不会对调用者做身份认证，也无法设置按用户的流量控制，若开放该API请设置好按API的流量控制；
     - AppCodeAuthType的值不会生效
parameters.name: auth_type

parameters.help_en: The protocol types supported by the API. You can specify multiple values and separate them with commas (,), such as HTTP,HTTPS. Valid values: HTTP and HTTPS
parameters.help_zh: API 支持的协议类型，可以多选，多选情况下以英文逗号隔开，如：”HTTP,HTTPS”，取值为：HTTP、HTTPS
parameters.name: request_protocol

parameters.help_en: The HTTP method. Valid values: GET, POST, DELETE, PUT, HEADER, TRACE, PATCH, CONNECT, and OPTIONS
parameters.help_zh: HTTP Method，取值为：GET、POST、DELETE、PUT、HEADER、TRACE、PATCH、CONNECT、OPTIONS
parameters.name: request_http_method

parameters.help_en: The API path. For example, if the complete URL of the API is `http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`, the path is `/object/add`
parameters.help_zh: API path，比如API的完全地址为`http://api.a.com：8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`，path是指`/object/add`这一部分
parameters.name: request_path

parameters.help_en:
The request mode for input parameters. Valid values:
MAPPING: Maps input parameters and filters out unknown parameters.
PASSTHROUGH: Passes through input parameters.
MAPPING_PASSTHROUGH: Maps input parameters and passes through unknown parameters
parameters.help_zh:
入参请求的模式，取值为：

MAPPING：入参映射（过滤未知参数）

PASSTHROUGH：入参透传

MAPPING_PASSTHROUGH：入参映射（透传未知参数）
parameters.name: request_mode

parameters.help_en:
The format of the request body. This parameter takes effect only when RequestMode is set to MAPPING. For POST or PUT requests, this parameter specifies how data is passed to the server. Valid values:
FORM: form data, which consists of key-value pairs
STREAM: byte stream
parameters.help_zh:
当RequestMode值为MAPPING时有效。

POST/PUT请求时，表示数据以何种方式传递给服务器，取值为：FORM、STREAM，分别表示表单形式(k-v对应)、字节流形式
parameters.name: body_format

parameters.help_en: The description of the request body
parameters.help_zh: 请求body描述
parameters.name: post_body_description

parameters.help_en: The body model
parameters.help_zh: body模型
parameters.name: body_model

parameters.help_en: The name of the model
parameters.help_zh: 模型的名称
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The backend service name. This parameter takes effect only when UseBackendService is set to TRUE
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务名称
UseBackendService置为TRUE时才会生效
parameters.name: backend_name

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of Terms of Service. Valid values:
Http: HTTP or HTTPS backend
Vpc: VPC backend
FC: Function Compute backend
OSS: Object Storage Service (OSS) backend
Mock: mock backend
EventBridge: EventBridge backend
You must specify the configuration information of the corresponding backend service by assigning values to the config parameters of Terms of Service
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务协议类型，目前支持：
Http： http/https后端
Vpc： Vpc后端
FC： 函数计算后端
OSS： 对象存储后端
Mock： mock后端
EventBridge： 事件总线后端

需要指明对应后端服务的配置信息，即为对应的后端服务的config参数赋值
parameters.name: service_protocol

parameters.help_en: The HTTP configuration
parameters.help_zh: http配置信息
parameters.name: http_config

parameters.help_en: The VPC configuration
parameters.help_zh: vpc配置
parameters.name: vpc_config

parameters.help_en: The Function Compute configuration
parameters.help_zh: 函数计算配置信息
parameters.name: function_compute_config

parameters.help_en: The OSS configuration
parameters.help_zh: OSS配置信息
parameters.name: oss_config

parameters.help_en: The mock configuration
parameters.help_zh: Mock配置信息
parameters.name: mock_config

parameters.help_en: The timeout period of the backend service. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 后端服务超时时间，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: service_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The Content-Type configuration for backend requests. Valid values:
DEFAULT: the default Content-Type of API Gateway
CUSTOM: a custom Content-Type
parameters.help_zh:
后端请求ContentType配置
DEFAULT：API网关默认
CUSTOM：自定义
parameters.name: content_type_category

parameters.help_en: The value of the Content-Type header when the backend service is an HTTP service and ContentTypeCategory is set to DEFAULT or CUSTOM
parameters.help_zh: 调用后端服务HTTP服务，ContentTypeCatagory的值为DEFAULT或者CUSTOM时，ContentType头的取值
parameters.name: content_type_value

parameters.help_en:
The description of the parameters that the consumer sends to API Gateway in an API request.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43986.html
parameters.help_zh:
Consumer向网关发送API请求的参数描述。

更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43986.html
parameters.name: request_parameters

parameters.help_en:
The description of the parameters that API Gateway sends to the backend service in an API request.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43988.html
parameters.help_zh:
网关向后端服务发送API请求的参数描述。

更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43988.html
parameters.name: service_parameters

parameters.help_en:
The mapping between the parameters that the consumer sends to API Gateway and the parameters that API Gateway sends to the backend service.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43989.html
parameters.help_zh:
Consumer向网关发送请求的参数和网关向后端服务发送的请求的参数的映射关系。

更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43989.html
parameters.name: service_parameters_map

parameters.help_en:
The format of the response returned by the backend service. Valid values: JSON, TEXT, BINARY, XML, and HTML.
This value is used only to generate documentation and does not affect the actual response
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务返回应答的格式，目前可以设置为：JSON、TEXT、BINARY、XML、HTML。
该值仅用于生成文档使用。不对返回结果产生影响
parameters.name: result_type

parameters.help_en:
The sample response returned by the backend service.
This value is used only to generate documentation and does not affect the actual response
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务返回应答的示例
该值仅用于生成文档使用。不对返回结果产生影响
parameters.name: result_sample

parameters.help_en:
The sample error response returned by the backend service.
This value is used only to generate documentation and does not affect the actual response
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务失败返回应答的示例
该值仅用于生成文档使用。不对返回结果产生影响
parameters.name: fail_result_sample

parameters.help_en:
The sample error codes returned by the backend service.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44392.html
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务返回的错误码示例。

更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44392.html
parameters.name: error_code_samples

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the created backend EPS resource is used. Valid values:
TRUE: Uses the created backend service.
FALSE: Uses custom backend service information
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用创建的后端服务资源：
TRUE：使用创建的后端服务
FALSE：自定义后端服务信息
parameters.name: use_backend_service
